note: What a person saw when they looked at each GPU run's stills and frames (the founder's reviewer). A rejected product is still evaluated, so its numbers show the failure, but it gets no renders and is left off the blind page. A faulty product is evaluated and rendered so the fault can be seen, but it is not a panel bundle and is left off the blind page. Verdicts: accepted, faulty, rejected.

azure-palm-baby-doll-dress.why: run 17b (stage 2 + 4 on run 16a's FASHN stills recomposed with stage 1b QA 0.12.0: the back still's 49 px cut tie string below the hem left out; same seeds as 16b): no grey cap above the sleeves in the stills or any turntable frame; nothing hangs below the hem of either still; run 16b's see-through lower skirt with the grey leg through and ragged tips (turntable_a 32-56) and its strings (40-80) are gone; print, puff sleeves, babydoll as in runs 15 and 16b. Open, flagged, not repaired: (1) the plain cream unprinted flap swinging out at one side of the hem in turntable_b frames about 82-155 is unchanged from 16b (not seeded by the string); (2) new: a flat, hard-edged, unprinted pale rectangle at the image's left beside the hem in turntable_a frames 13-31 (fainter also at the right at about 20-28; up to ~10 cm at 28), partly detached at 16-20, fully detached from the skirt at frame 30 (gap up to 18 px at row 520, 30 px at row 527) and gone in one frame at 31 (a local 41-51 px jump; no global flicker); both are fitted as a wider hem (hem girth 157.7 cm against run 15's 149.5); (3) 2 vertices 3.2 mm from the mannequin (clearance 4 mm); (4) the grey back-shoulder patch in AU 8 from the side and the straight side view; (5) the motion clip draws a sleeveless strappy dress (not used). Accepted pending founder review: 17b over 16b is a judgement call between two different visible defects (16b: the grey leg through a see-through lower skirt in turntable_a 32-56 plus strings; 17b: the floating flat panel in 13-31); neither is panel-clean; founder to choose. For 17b: chest -0.50 cm, flat-lay -1.00 cm, holdout IoU level; against: hem girth +1.8 cm, skirt Chamfer 1.13 against 1.06. Stage 2 consistency re-scored on CPU with 0.4.0 (the GPU run wrote 0.3.0, no off-reference check): 89 of 243 frames flagged; off the stills' hull below the hips at the image-left in turntable_a j19-30 (12 frames, up to 2,249 px: the pale rectangle; its first frames 13-18 are under the 400 px threshold) and turntable_b j18-78 (frames 98-158, 61 frames, up to 1,237 px: the cream flap; by eye it starts earlier, about frame 82), so the report now marks its hem girth UNCONFIRMED; other flags: garment IoU vs the stills low in turntable_a 4 and turntable_b 14 frames, skirt cover in turntable_a 1 frame, the motion clip (not used) 11. Looked at by the evaluating agent, not yet by the founder

crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt.why: run 17d (stage 2 + 4 on the reviewed stills front fashn@44 + back fashn@63 from run 17c, recomposed with QA 0.12.0): THE HIPS ARE CLOSED (run 15's fault): no grey hip beside the skirt in any front or back frame (at most 3 px against run 15's up to 1,356 px, >50 px in 46 of 62 such frames), no side slit in any side view, and the asset has no opening wider than 4 cm anywhere between 3 and 99 cm above the floor (run 15: open at both hips, 10.2 and 7.8 cm across); pale pink smocked waistband front and back, print and tier band right; hip 110.35 cm by the tape against the chart's 109 with ease (+1.35); holdout IoU 0.947 / 0.947 (run 15 0.915 / 0.883). Open, flagged, not repaired: (1) no girth at the chart's only critical anchor: the band's top edge is 100.2 cm above the floor, 4.0 cm below our waist ring (104.2), so chart agreement FAILS (band girth 88.07 cm against 80.5 with ease, +7.57, uncalibrated, global scale 1.000) and the plugin's import gate refuses the bundle (qa_failed): it is NOT in the demo shop; (2) the hem is drawn over the feet: red 'boots' round both feet below the hem in most of turntable_b (85-159) and in turntable_a 40-49, so the asset's hem sits 2.2 cm above the floor (P0's maxi 11.4) and pinches in round the ankles (hem girth 86.0 cm, flare 0.78 against the hip; P0 1.25, 3.9 sigma), two foot-shaped lobes at the hem in the viewer, the grey toes just below it; (3) stage 2 flaps: translucent pale side panels on both sides of the hem in turntable_b 81-84 and a flat red tongue on the floor at the image-left in 83-94 (consistency 0.4.0 off-reference turntable_b j1-6, up to 1,504 px; the tongue mostly under the threshold), and the hem flaring out at the image-right in turntable_a 1-14 (up to 1,928 px), j71-79 (489) and b j79 (524); so the hem girth is UNCONFIRMED; (4) the baked print is smeared into vertical streaks in the viewer, with pale unprinted patches at the hem (texture holdout MAE 29.2 against one colour 34.4); (5) AU 8 / 12 / 16 differ only a little in the viewer (graded from the hip only). FAULTY, not a panel bundle, pending a founder decision: the founder's objection (the hips) is gone and no slit or hole shows, but the bundle fails the plugin's own import gate (no girth at its only critical anchor), so no shop could show it, and the grey toes show just below the hem drawn over the feet; AU 8 / 12 / 16 barely differ, which a size-picking panel needs. The founder decides whether the skirt is worn low (then the chart's waist anchor must move to the band) or new stills are needed whose band reaches the waist. Consistency 0.4.0's 41 flagged frames: 30 off-reference (above) and 11 more (turntable_a j15-25) only for skirt cover 0.865-0.899 < 0.9 below the crotch; j7-14 carry both; looked at by eye, frames 15-25 are a normal three-quarter rotation whose lower skirt is a little narrower than the stills' hull (the hem drawn in round the feet, item 2), no flap, slit or grey; not a new defect. Looked at by the evaluating agent (every render, all 160 turntable frames), not yet by the founder

rosewater-blouse.why: FASHN stills torn (patches of print with the mannequin showing through, the back a pale blotchy shirt); stage 2 frames contain black panels on the back and side. Stage 2 ran anyway because --accept-failed-dress overrides the silhouette and fidelity failures

rosewater-palazzo-pants.why: run 17d (stage 2 + 4 on run 16a's Qwen front and back, approved by the founder with the invented pocket flap and the darker print, unchanged by QA 0.12.0): the stage 2 frames are good: two legs in every turntable frame (touching down to a seam line over up to 65% of the leg rows in a 75-76 and b 155-156), no grey, no flap, no black frame (consistency 0.4.0: 4 of 160 turntable frames flagged for merged legs, a 75-76 and b 155-156, where the wide legs touch down to a seam line next to the pinned views; the motion clip, not used, merges them in 62 of 81 frames). Stage 4t fits two leg tubes and a seat tube (separate components), chart PASS: waist 82.68 cm against 79.5 with ease (+3.18 before calibration, +1.30 after the global scale), hip 119.83 against 118 (+1.83); outseam 102.51 cm against the printed 99 (+3.51), inseam 73.59 from the crotch at 76.44 cm, hem 5.3 cm above the floor; holdout IoU 0.970 / 0.964. FAULTY, not for the panel: (1) in the viewer, at every size and on every body (M, XS, XXL), the leg tubes drop away from the seat in the drape and a band of our grey thighs shows between the seat and the legs from the front, three-quarter and side, with the legs crumpled below (the static mesh is closed, so this is the unstitched leg tubes in the drape, but it is what the asset shows); (2) narrow grey slivers of our shins show through vertical slits low in the leg tubes in the three-quarter and side views (and the XXL front) at AU 8, 12 and 16 alike; (3) 1 vertex inside the mannequin (share 0.0002); (4) the baked print is a patchwork: a blurred, stretched rectangle between the crotch and the knees with hard seams at both ends (texture holdout MAE 29.1, worse than one mean colour, 27.6). Not repaired; next: stitch the leg tubes to the seat (or pin their tops) in the bundle/viewer and re-bake, on CPU, and check the lower-leg slits as well as the thigh band
